title: private-deploy-field-notes
content:
Notes to self / daily scratchpad - private deployments (VPC/on-prem)

2024-11-09 - quick log
- Morning call with Acme Corp infra (10:00). Confirmed they will open firewall rules by EOD.
- Ran kube prechecks against staging cluster (on-prem). Found two issues: node labels missing (zone labels) and old kubelet (1.22) on two nodes.

Top-level TODOs:
- [ ] File follow-up with Acme infra: ask for outage window for kubelet upgrade (linked INF-872).
- [ ] Prepare new helm values for air-gapped install (imagePullSecrets + local registry).
- [ ] Add customer-specific certs to cert-manager helm values (they provide wildcard).
- [ ] Verify KMS integration (HSM) with Private control plane (need sample envelope).

Quick install checklist (notes / gotchas):
- Network: need these ports open inbound/outbound: 443, 2379-2380 (etcd), 10250 (kubelet), 30000-32767 (nodePort range optional). Specify across AZs for HA.
- DNS: customer uses split-horizon; ensure internal DNS record for console.redwood.local -> LB internal IP.
- MTU: default 1500 is fine but if they have jumbo frames, set CNI accordingly (we saw packet fragmentation once).
- Proxy: if customer has outbound proxy, set NO_PROXY for control-plane IPs + internal registries.
- Time sync: critical. Confirm chronyd/ntpd running on all nodes before install.

On-prem prechecks commands (stubs):
- kubectl get nodes -o wide  # look for kubelet versions, ready status
- ssh node01 sudo journalctl -u kubelet --since "2h" | tail -n 200
- curl -vk https://console.redwood.internal:443  # check TLS handshake from inside cluster

Known blockers seen previously:
- Customer firewall applying new rules only after change window -> delays rollout by 24-48h. Put this in rollout notes and set canary to 0 traffic until network confirmed.
- Internal registries with expired certs -> image pulls fail. Always test image pull from a bastion host using same registry creds.
- SELinux/AppArmor policies blocking volume mounts for GKE-like CSI drivers on older kernels. Recommend checking dmesg for AVC denials.

Customer environment reminders (Acme Corp):
- Private subnet ranges: 10.40.0.0/16 (k8s nodes), 10.41.0.0/24 (control-plane), VPN peer IP: 198.51.100.22
- KMS: Thales Luna 7.x at 10.41.0.10 - need contact + test key (Samir to own).
- SSO: Okta SAML - metadata URL provided in linked confluence page.

Quick recovery steps if console not reachable:
- Check LB health -> backend pods -> logs (console service).
- Exec into control-plane pod, try curl against local KV cache endpoint.
- Rollback canary to previous model by switching modelRef in config and restart route-controller (graceful).

Notes / fragments to expand later:
- Write a short runbook for cert rotation during air-gapped installs (include steps to upload cert tarball to registry).
- Template a kubeadm/kubespray precheck script (detect old kubelet, unschedulable nodes, disk pressure).

Links referenced during call:
- Confluence install checklist (see linked_artifacts).
- INF-872 - Acme infra follow-up ticket.
- PR #214 - helm values for private deploy (draft).

Action items for today:
- 11:30: ping Acme infra for firewall confirmation (if not confirmed, pause canary).
- 14:00: pair with Samir to test KMS envelope exchange in staging.
- End of day: commit helm values changes to PR #214 and ask Maya for quick review.

Random reminders to self:
- keep copy of customer CA in vault (path: secrets/private-deploys/acme/ca.pem) - verify access rights first.
- take screenshots of LB health checks before escalation.

End of notes (draft).
